transcript: If there's a woman in your home who loves to lie down, don't be so quick to call her lazy. Sometimes the one who looks the most still is the one carrying the most unseen weight. In Eastern thought, there's an idea called the human feng shui formation. It speaks about how a person's presence alone can influence the energy of a space. When she lies down, it doesn't always mean she's doing nothing. She may be restoring herself, resetting her nervous system, rebalancing after giving her energy to everyone else. Rest is not weakness, it is renewal, and the one who gives emotionally, mentally, spiritually, often needs more stillness than others. So if she stretches out on the couch or sinks quietly into the bed, don't rush to judge. Maybe she's not withdrawing, maybe she's recovering, maybe her calm is what keeps the house from becoming chaos. Learn to recognize quiet strength. It doesn't always look productive, but it holds everything together.
